title: 第11章 灵宝阁第12章 固灵佩
content_zh:
来到东城的叶家商铺，直奔三楼而去。
“咚，咚，咚”
“父亲，母亲，我是叶非凡，今天有点事情想跟你们说下。”
“直接进来吧”房里传来孙素素的声音。
叶非凡推门进入后，才发现只有母亲孙素素一个人在房里，似乎刚刚在处理一些事情，而父亲则不知所踪。
“母亲，父亲现在在商铺吗，我有点事情想和你们说下。”叶非凡连忙问道。
“他在二楼和一位客人商谈丹药方面的事情，已经去了很久了，估计马上就会回来，你先等会吧。”
“好，那我在这等一下。”
孙素素便接着问起一些关于叶非凡修为境界上的事情。
而叶非凡也一一老实作答，毕竟没什么机密之类的，一切都正常。
也就过了一会，房门便被推开，只见叶虎慢慢走了进来，看见叶非凡坐在那和孙素素聊天，便问道
“你小子怎么过来了，肯定有事情吧，平常要你来学习你都不来的。”
“嘿嘿，其实我是打算以后多过来和您还有母亲学习下商铺的事情的，但今天的确有事情要和你们二位说。”叶非凡抓抓脑袋，笑着说道，似乎有点不好意思。
“那说吧，什么事。”
“是这样的，今天早上大哥叶飞扬来找我了，问了下我的修炼情况后直接给了我一个微型聚灵阵图和12颗下品灵石，并且嘱咐我不要让同辈们知道。我想着我用这些修炼速度加快后，肯定瞒不过你们2位，便打算直接跟你们说下，并且如果我最近修炼速度又快速不少，同辈们要是问起来，那该怎么给出一个合理的解释，这个也想向你们请教下。”
听完叶非凡说的事情，叶虎和孙素素都有点震惊，相互看了看眼，还是叶虎先说话。
“我们有想过叶飞扬可能也会偷偷帮下你，但没想到是直接给了个聚灵阵图，这手笔对他来说也不算小，毕竟他修炼也需要大量资源。”
“而且这个的确有点麻烦，万一让其他同辈人知道了，难免会觉得对你过于偏袒，这个对于他叶家大哥的身份来说影响很大。”
听见父亲叶虎也这么说了，叶非凡便试探性说道
“那我就不要一直用微型聚灵阵图修炼吧，这样修炼速度就不会快的很离谱，大家也就不会注意到这一点了，真要问起来，就说您又给我找了几颗聚气丹用来修炼。”

父亲叶虎一听，就不答应
“那不行，本来你就落后同龄人一大截，现在有机会，肯定要追赶上去，这微型聚灵阵可以说是你的机缘，咱们修炼者还没有害怕机缘这一说的。”
“那就说是您们2位送给我的微型聚灵阵吧，这样子是不是也可以，其实只要不要让同辈们知道是叶飞扬大哥送我的就行了。”
叶非凡想了想，说出了一个办法来。
“这个也可以，那我就准备一番说辞来解释这个微型聚灵阵得由来。”
叶虎也觉得这样可以。
忽然，孙素素说道
“老叶，我们之前准备的那个东西，是不是可以提前给非凡啊，这样子，叶飞扬的事情也不需要解释了。”
“嗯？这么一说的话，好像是可以。只不过提前的话，那我就得先去找家主商量商量。”
叶虎听完眼睛一亮。
听着父母眼前的对话，叶非凡不明所以。
“谜语人滚出辉月城！！”
虽然很想说出这句话，但那也就是想想而已。
“给我的东西？难道外挂就正好借此机会发放吗？转了这么大一个圈，还是要通过父亲给啊，不过好像也挺合理，有不少小说是这个套路，虽然来迟了点，但我也能接受，哈哈哈哈。”
叶非凡突然意识到什么，心跳有点加快。
content_en:
Arriving at Ye's store in Dongcheng, he went straight to the third floor.
"Boom, boom, boom"
"Father, mother, I am Ye Feifan. I have something to tell you today."
"Come in directly." Sun Susu's voice came from the room.
After Ye Feifan pushed the door open and entered, he found that only his mother, Sun Susu, was in the room. She seemed to be dealing with something just now, and her father was missing.
"Mother, is father in the store now? I have something to tell you." Ye Feifan asked quickly.
"He is discussing elixirs with a customer on the second floor. He has been there for a long time. He will probably be back soon. Please wait for a while."
"Okay, then I'll wait here."
Sun Susu then asked some things about Ye Feifan's cultivation level.
Ye Feifan also answered honestly. After all, there were no secrets and everything was normal.
After a while, the door was pushed open and Ye Hu slowly walked in. Seeing Ye Feifan sitting there chatting with Sun Susu, he asked
"Why are you here, kid? There must be something going on. Normally you wouldn't come to study if I ask you to."
"Hehe, I actually planned to come over more often in the future to learn about the store from you and my mother, but I do have something to talk to you two about today." Ye Feifan scratched his head and said with a smile, seeming a little embarrassed.
"Then tell me what's going on."
"It's like this. My eldest brother Ye Feiyang came to see me this morning. After asking about my cultivation situation, he gave me a miniature spirit gathering array and 12 low-grade spirit stones, and told me not to let my peers know about it. I thought I would use these cultivation speeds After speeding up, I will definitely not be able to hide it from you two, so I plan to tell you directly, and if my peers ask me if my cultivation speed has been much faster recently, I would like to ask you how to give a reasonable explanation. "
After hearing what Ye Feifan said, Ye Hu and Sun Susu were both a little shocked. They looked at each other, but Ye Hu spoke first.
"We thought that Ye Feiyang might also secretly help you, but we didn't expect that he directly gave you a spirit gathering array diagram. This is not a small gesture for him. After all, his cultivation also requires a lot of resources."
"And this is indeed a bit troublesome. If other people of your generation find out, they will inevitably feel that they are too partial to you. This will have a great impact on his status as the eldest brother of the Ye family."
Hearing his father Ye Hu say the same thing, Ye Feifan tentatively said
"Then I shouldn't keep using the miniature spirit-gathering array to practice. This way the practice speed won't be ridiculously fast, and no one will notice it. If I really want to ask, just tell me that you found a few more energy-gathering pills for me to practice with."
When his father Ye Hu heard this, he refused to agree.
"That won't work. You were already far behind your peers. Now that you have the opportunity, you must catch up. This miniature spirit gathering array can be said to be your opportunity. We cultivators are not afraid of opportunities."
"Then let's just say it was the miniature spirit gathering array that you two gave me. Is that okay? In fact, as long as my peers don't know that it was Brother Ye Feiyang who gave it to me."
Ye Feifan thought for a while and came up with a solution.
"This is okay, then I will prepare some words to explain the origin of this miniature spirit gathering array."
Ye Hu also thinks this is okay.
Suddenly, Sun Susu said
"Old Ye, can the thing we prepared before be given to Fei Fei in advance? In this way, Ye Feiyang's matter does not need to be explained."
"Huh? That sounds like it's possible. But if I do it in advance, I have to go to the head of the family to discuss it first."
Ye Hu's eyes lit up after hearing this.
Listening to the conversation in front of his parents, Ye Feifan was confused.
"The Riddler, get out of Huiyue City!!"
Although I really want to say this, I just want to think about it.
"Give me something? Is it a plug-in?"Just take this opportunity to distribute it? After going through such a big circle, I still have to give it through my father, but it seems quite reasonable. There are many novels that follow this routine. Although it is a little late, I can accept it, hahahaha. "
Ye Feifan suddenly realized something and his heart beat a little faster.
